platforms.rule: Only platform contact edge may be visually strong. Decorative body must not hide player.

hazards.rule: Must read faster than decor but not cover player unfairly.

bonuses.rule: Must be readable but less visually dominant than player.

npc_decor.rule: NPC decor must enrich level, not compete with player.

labels_signage.rule: Gameplay labels short and readable; background jokes dim.

ui_achievements.rule: Do not use noisy gameplay textures as achievement card backgrounds.

foreground_decor.rule: Foreground decor adds depth but must never hide the player's body or platform contact edge.

background_decor.rule: Background decor supports the story and stays behind gameplay readability bands.
